_about: Index decisions for generated /pricing/ pages, applied by scripts/build-pricing.js. Since 2026-11-26 (M-03): a pricing page is indexable only when its price is verified AND the tool is a core tool (index.html programs), has a review, or is listed under keep. keep = directory tools with proven search demand (50+ impressions in the 28 days before the 2026-11-09 drop) or added later by the weekly SEO routine from Search Console data, each with date and reason. noindex = pages Google crawled and left out for 28+ days (scripts/index-report.js), applied even to core tools. Remove an entry to undo it.
